recommendation: Implement trusted instruction boundaries and prompt-injection defenses.
details: Treat retrieved documents and external content as untrusted data. Never allow instructions inside retrieved content to override the system prompt or expose credentials.

recommendation: Implement cryptographic agent authentication and authorization.
details: Validate the identity and authenticity of every inter-agent message. Use signed messages, scoped permissions, and least-privilege access. Do not trust sender identities supplied as ordinary text.

recommendation: Secure tool execution and monitor sensitive operations.
details: Require explicit authorization for privileged MCP tool calls. Apply tool allowlists, input validation, approval checks, audit logging, and monitoring for suspicious actions.
